archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY (Warm Trust, Personal & Calm)

typography.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight
typography.label_text: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-stone-500 dark:text-stone-400

color_palette.theme_mode: Warm Light (Default) with Dark Mode toggle support

layout_and_spacing.generous_spacing: Use p-6 to p-8 inside cards, py-16 to py-24 for marketing sections
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: 3-column grid for summary stats (Balance, Expense, Income), 8-col / 4-col split for main chart and quick Telegram feed
layout_and_spacing.card_style: Flat surface with 1px border (#E7E2D8), gentle rounded-2xl corners, hover elevation translate-y-[-2px] shadow-sm
layout_and_spacing.header_style: Sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-stone-900/80 border-b border-stone-200/50 dark:border-stone-800/50 (NEVER fully transparent)

components_and_features.landing_hero: Interactive live Telegram Chat Mockup where user clicks sample prompts ('jajan 15k', receipt photo, or voice note) to watch it parse live into structured expense item in real-time.
components_and_features.google_auth: Emergent Google Sign-In modal/button with clear Indonesian user consent ('Masuk dengan Google').

dashboard_summary.total_balance_card: Hero balance display with trend indicator (+% vs last month)
dashboard_summary.income_vs_expense_cards: Dual mini-cards showing total income and total expenses with progress bar
dashboard_summary.spending_category_pie: Interactive Donut chart using Recharts with legend & breakdown list
dashboard_summary.daily_trend_chart: Smooth Area chart or Bar chart with date filter toggles (7 Hari, Bulan Ini, 30 Hari, Custom)

transactions_list.filters: Search by title/notes, Filter by Type (Semua, Pengeluaran, Pemasukan), Category dropdown filter, Date range picker
transactions_list.actions: Manual Add Expense/Income dialog, Edit Transaction modal, Delete confirmation, Export CSV trigger

telegram_linking_page.step_by_step: 1. Buka Bot Telegram (@CatatYuk_Bot) -> 2. Kirim Kode Hubungkan -> 3. Terhubung secara instant!
telegram_linking_page.otp_card: Unique 6-digit link code with 1-click copy button & QR code option
telegram_linking_page.connection_status: Live badge indicator (Terhubung / Belum Terhubung) with unpair option

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: ALL buttons, inputs, filter select, charts, dialog triggers, and data displays MUST have descriptive data-testid (e.g., data-testid='add-transaction-btn', data-testid='filter-category-select', data-testid='telegram-code-display')
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standard: APCA & WCAG AA compliant contrast on warm cream (#FAF8F5) background
testing_and_accessibility.micro_interactions: Framer Motion page transitions, button spring hover, live toast notifications (sonner) when transaction added or deleted

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete JavaScript React application (using .js files) under /app/frontend.
Include both Landing Marketing Page view and Auth/Dashboard views seamlessly.

Implement full local storage state management pre-populated with realistic Indonesian financial records (e.g. 'Kopi Susu Gula Aren Rp 18.000', 'Gaji Bulanan Rp 8.500.000', 'Bensin Pertamax Rp 50.000', 'Makan Siang Padang Rp 25.000').
Ensure the Telegram bot simulator allows typing 'jajan 25k' or uploading a dummy receipt image to immediately append a new item to the dashboard state.
Add Export CSV logic that downloads an actual .csv file formatted for Indonesian financial accounting.
Ensure all components are responsive, high-craft, elegant, and warm.
